findings.statement: The bounded PR-283 runtime and receipt replay is internally deterministic and fail-closed: 16 current-tree source bindings match, all 10 mutations execute and die, two check runs reproduce one receipt hash, stale receipt bytes are rejected, and the frozen PR-272 relocation replay passes.

Their selectors pass 90/90 and 22/22 only after adding repository source roots to PYTHONPATH, so the defect is command bootstrap, not the selected tests.

claim_results.summary: PR-283 runtime replay and artifact integrity pass, but the mutable candidate is not ready to freeze: two exact direct-pytest policy lanes lack repository-root import bootstrap, the strict claim command names a missing PR delta, and portable clean replay remains blocked until a committed candidate exists.
